youtube_title: Forgot Your Licence? Is DigiLocker Valid? Rules You Didn't Know #9 #Shorts
youtube_description:
RULES YOU DIDN'T KNOW #9. Police checking, and your licence is at home. Will DigiLocker on your phone work? A: no, original needed. B: yes.
Answer: B. In August 2018 the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways told states that a driving licence, RC and other documents in DigiLocker or mParivahan are legally recognised at par with the originals under the IT Act 2000, and there is no need to physically seize originals - it is recorded electronically.
Show the verified document inside the app, not a photo from your gallery.
Source: MoRTH advisory, Aug 2018.

Checking hui aur licence ghar pe bhool gaye 😬 Phone mein DigiLocker hai — chalega? A: nahi, original chahiye. B: haan, chalega.
Sahi hai B — Transport Ministry (MoRTH) advisory, Aug 2018: DigiLocker / mParivahan wala licence aur RC original ke barabar valid. Original seize karne ki bhi zaroorat nahi, sab electronically record hota hai.
Bas gallery ki photo nahi, app wala verified document dikhana.
